name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for one requested time slot and answers Available or Unavailable. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (10:00 = 600, 24:00 = 1440). This tool only checks: it does not save, create or change any booking.

start.description: Requested start, in whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end, in whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, in whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked, false if it is not.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room. May be empty.
